steps: Invoke artifact show and its show alias through CLI, structured request and Python on actual project files.

oracle.scope: Real project-bound Show returns full stored artifact data, every incoming/outgoing relation and original edge identity, including computed superseded_by. CLI alias, canonical command, structured request, Python and relocated distributions use the same reader. Existing read preflight and full artifact-source observation are enforced; no project writes, cache creation or approval are claimed.
